evidence.reason: Ordinary code-correctness asymmetry in the containment evidence builder. The published patch is rejected when it is a binary diff (lines 1306-1308), because a binary patch carries no text hunks. The head patch computed at lines 1314-1315 is passed straight into change_undone at lines 1319-1320 with no equivalent check. If a later commit replaces the text file with binary content while keeping mode 100644, before != after (blob changed) so the identical shortcut does not fire, the published patch still has text hunks, but diff_changed_locations(head_patch) returns empty lists, change_undone returns false, and mode_changed is false, so the code records status 'contained' even though the published added line is gone. That records an unverified repair as contained instead of requiring revalidation. Smallest compatible fix: after computing head_patch, apply the same 'Binary files '/'GIT binary patch' rejection used for published_patch (raise the same needs-revalidation ValueError), keeping the identical-blob shortcut and the text-patch comparison intact. No contract clause is needed; this is a defect in existing intended behavior.
